Optimize code and systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput workloads in hyperscale environments. Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure designs and implementations satisfy them. Design for elastic capacity, enabling systems to scale up and down efficiently with demand. Use data-plane platforms to support large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. Design and execute performance and load-testing strategies. Design systems to manage service disruptions, including network partitions, with explicit tradeoffs among consistency, availability, and partition tolerance. Implement and optimize resilience mechanisms for network unreliability, including load shedding, throttling, and rate limiting. Design durable components and systems that meet service-level objectives (SLOs) and establish clear availability and durability expectations for dependent services. System Reliability: Performance, Observability & Correctness Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry that reveal gaps and issues in production systems. Build and tailor dashboards, telemetry pipelines, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor component and system health. Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for features and systems, whether new or existing. Design complex test scenarios, including fault-injection and brownout testing, to validate system correctness. Implement data replication and synchronization techniques that preserve data integrity and availability. Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management Proactively diagnose, debug, and resolve issues in active components and systems; mentor others in effective troubleshooting practices. Implement approaches that avoid customer maintenance windows when resolving issues and minimize service interruption. Maintain deep expertise in owned components and systems to enable effective troubleshooting and performance optimization. Meet operational-readiness expectations through thoughtful design and implementation. Participate in operational support rotations and provide leadership during incident response and root-cause investigations. Develop and maintain automation tools and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) to manage cloud infrastructure. Create and follow change-management plans for patching, updates, and rollbacks; design systems that increasingly automate these processes. Delegate, prioritize, and provide technical oversight across multiple projects, adapting plans as resourcing or timelines change.
